# Local compatibility package

This is a local compatibility copy of [`vite-plugin-functions-mixins`](https://github.com/KTibow/vite-plugin-functions-mixins), version 0.4.1. The plugin uses Vite's plugin hooks and Node filesystem APIs; this copy updates the declared Vite peer range to Vite 8 so npm can resolve the frontend's Vite 8 toolchain without bypassing peer checks.

The upstream package is MIT-licensed. See [LICENSE](LICENSE). Recheck upstream compatibility before updating this copy.
